title: Fairytale Of New York
original_lyrics:
[verse]
It was Christmas Eve, babe

[intro]
An old man said to me
"Won't see another one"
And then he sang song
'The Rare Old Mountain Dew'
I turned my face away
And dreamed about you

[verse]
Got on lucky one

[chorus]
I've got feeling
This year's for me and you
So, Happy Christmas
I love you, baby
I can see better time
When all our dreams come true

[verse]
They've got cars big as bars
They've got rivers of gold

[bridge]
It's no place for the old
When you first took my hand
On cold Christmas Eve
You promised me Broadway
Was waiting for me

[verse]
"You were handsome!" "You were pretty
Queen of New York City"
When the band finished playing
They howled out for more
Sinatra was swinging
All the drunks, they were singing
And we kissed on corner
Then danced through the night
And the boys of the NYPD choir
Were singing 'Galway Bay'
And the bells were ringing out
For Christmas day

[verse]
"You're bum, you're punk"
"You're an old cut on junk
Lying there almost dead
On drip in that bed"
"You scumbag, you maggot
You cheap lousy ?
Maybe Christmas, you mother
I pray God it's our last"
And the boys of the NYPD choir
Were singing 'Galway Bay'
And the bells were ringing out
For Christmas day

[verse]
"I could have been someone"
"Well, so could anyone
You took my dreams from me
When I first found you"
"I took them with me, babe
I kept them with my own

[chorus]
I've built my dreams around you"
And the boys of the NYPD choir
Were singing 'Galway Bay'
And the bells were ringing out
For Christmas day

[outro]
Jingle bells, jingle bells, jingle all the way
Oh, what fun it is to ride in one horse open sleigh hey
Jingle bells, jingle bells, jingle all the way
Oh, what fun it is to ride in one horse open sleigh hey
Dashing through the snow
On one horse open sleigh
O'er the fields we go
Laughing all the way

[bridge]
Making spirits bright
What fun it is to ride and sing
sleighing song tonight
Jingle bells, jingle bells, jingle all the way
Oh, what fun it is to ride in one horse open sleigh hey
Jingle bells, jingle bells, jingle all the way
Oh, what fun it is to ride in one horse open sleigh hey
